title: Southampton-Derby: Derby arrive with eight confirmed absences
text:
Southampton-Derby: Derby arrive with eight confirmed absences Tu Futbolero en Log in Sign up Back to the board News 23h ago · November 20, 2026 Southampton-Derby: Derby arrive with eight confirmed absences
 Southampton host Derby on Saturday 21 November in Championship matchday 16; Derby arrive with eight confirmed absences.
 By TuFutbolero Newsroom · November 20, 2026 at 08:39 AM 
 Live Southampton Derby Saturday 21 November · kick-off time TBC Line-ups, result and where to watch → Matchday 16 of the Championship sees Southampton host Derby on Saturday 21 November at St. Mary's Stadium. The referee will be Sam Allison.
 Southampton are fourth with 28 points from 15 matches. Their last five results are two wins, two draws and one defeat. Derby are 23rd with 10 points from 15 matches and, in their last five, have one win, one draw and three defeats.

 The hosts have two doubtful players: C. Jander, with a muscle injury, and C. Larin, with a hamstring injury. Derby have eight confirmed absences for the match: P. Agyemang (Achilles tendon), E. Cashin and M. Clarke (calf), C. Forsyth and S. Szmodics (knee), R. Hedges (muscle), S. Langas (groin) and D. Murkin (hamstring).
 In the five head-to-head meetings on record, Southampton have won twice and drawn three times, with no Derby wins. The most recent, on 11 April 2026, ended 2-1 to Southampton as the home side.
